# Tab

Navigate through different pages or sections that have the same context.
See [Tab guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/tab/design/)

<Canvas of={TabsStories.Basic} />

## Examples

### Variants

<Canvas of={TabsStories.Variants} />

Negative variant can be used on dark colored backgrounds

<Canvas of={TabsStories.Negative} />

### Dark mode

<Canvas of={TabsStories.Dark} />

```css
.bg-dark {
  background-color: #111111;
}
.p-1 {
  padding: 1rem;
}
```

### Floating

Floating option can be used to make the tabs visually float, without the bottom border line.
Tabs will also strech to full height of the parent.

<Canvas of={TabsStories.Floating} />

### Sizes

<Canvas of={TabsStories.Sizes} />

### Scrolling

On desktop when space is too limited to display a large amount of tabs, we recommend using a Menu instead.<br />
On Touch devices, you can use the `ds-tabs-scrollwrapper` wrapper class to allow user agent scrolling mechanisms (e.g. left/right swipe, shift-mousewheel, etc.)

<Canvas of={TabsStories.Scrolling} />

```css
.w-600 {
  width: 600px;
}
```
